title: The ChatGPT browser is already dead
slides: Why did your ChatGPT browser just vanish?
OpenAI removed it without warning last week.
The real reason: it was never built for you.
Now your workaround is a slower, clunkier tool.
Stop adapting. Demand a product that lasts.
thread_text:
1. Your ChatGPT just vanished.

OpenAI deleted the browser from your interface last week with zero notice.

2. It was never yours.

The tool was designed for their own testing, not for you to rely on.

3. The clunky workaround.

Now you're stuck copying text manually into a slower version that breaks every third time.

4. They shift, you adapt.

Every update moves your workflow to a worse alternative while you waste hours patching gaps.

5. Scream at the next update.

Next time you see a feature removed, file a bug report and tag @OpenAI on X. Does your habit justify their experiments?
